provider: hf-mirror.com / hf-mirror.net (Hugging Face mirror — read-only proxy)

free_tier.stated: None of its own — it is a transparent reverse proxy.

egress.terms: Free and anonymous for reads; resolves to HF's own CDN. Not applicable as a storage delta — the bytes live on HF, which is already known and excluded as a discovery.

tooling: Drop-in hostname swap: HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com for huggingface_hub / hf_transfer / rclone (rclone 'hf' backend points at it).
chaining: Only as an egress accelerator for an HF dataset you already have — it is a CDN in front of a host already on the known list, not a new quota.
limits_note: per-object-cap: inherits HF (50 GB/file at the time of the linked HF issues). Retention: inherits HF. Write path is redirected straight to huggingface.co, not mirrored: probe POST /api/repos/create -> 308 Location: https://huggingface.co/api/repos/create. So the mirror gives you nothing new to store INTO.
reliability_note: Reads work; One probe returned a bare 200 with an HTML body from the LFS batch endpoint rather than JSON — parse the body, not the status.

evidence.proved: (last revised 2026-09-11) — proxy-only positioning, no storage offered, no upload surface
probe: POST hf-mirror.com/api/repos/create -> 308 Location: (writes are not mirrored)

notes: None of its own — it is a transparent reverse proxy.

dead_end.why: None of its own — it is a transparent reverse proxy.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
